title: Escalation Routing Rule R-012: MLC case registration needed
content:
ROUTING RULE: R-012 -- MLC case registration needed
TRIGGER TYPE: Event
CONDITION: Trauma, poisoning, or assault presentation
ROUTE TO: Medical Records (MRD / HIM) (Extension 1030)
QUEUE: QUEUE_MRD
PRIORITY: URGENT
SLA: 1.0 hour(s)
ESCALATION RATIONALE: Statutory police intimation mandatory within 1 hour for medico-legal cases. Contact Medical Records ext. 1030.
EXAMPLE QUERY 1: Road traffic accident victim in emergency bay
EXAMPLE QUERY 2: Suspected domestic assault requires MLC
source_citation: SMCH Escalation Routing Matrix -- R-012 (MLC case registration needed) v1.0
